# Prime Deals

> Prime Deals makes custom technical apparel for combat sports academies and brands, produced in Peru and delivered from Lima. One order, one point of contact: definition, design, production, quality check and delivery. The site is in Spanish and English.

## Products
- [Rashguards](https://primedeals.global/rashguards): short and long sleeve, customized for academies and brands.
- [Shorts, compression shorts and leggings](https://primedeals.global/shorts)
- [All garments](https://primedeals.global/prendas): what we have made for jiu jitsu academies in Lima and Miami.

## Order terms (confirmed by the owner, 2026-11-08)
- Minimum order in Peru: 12 pieces per garment. For orders abroad: 50 pieces in total, at least 12 of each garment.
- Lead time: one dozen takes 3 to 5 business days, two dozen 5 to 7, larger orders about 7 to 10. The date is agreed in writing before production starts.
- Samples: we can make a sample. The full dozen is charged; if the buyer then orders the dozen, it counts as paid.
- Payment: 50% when the order is signed, 50% after visual confirmation of the finished order. Design work is paid up front.
- Shipments to the United States go with DHL.
- Sizes: kids and adult, our own patterns; special patterns can be discussed.
